'''Karish-Ma''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] living on [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he resided at the [[Outpost Overseer]], where he asked an Imperial to recover a bomb constructed by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]], despite the protests of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Visrak Ortano]], who wanted to destroy it.
